spans.s:
(इ) बहि r. 1st cl. (वंहते)
To grow or increase; also वहि, but upon inferior authority.

mfn. (-हुः-हुः-ह्वी-हु)
1 Much, many.
2 Large, great.
E.
बहि to increase, Uṇādi aff. कु; it is less correctly derived from वह to obtain, and written वहु.

m. (-हुः)
1 The arm.
2 The side of any angular geometrical figure, the leg of a triangle, &c.
E.
बाध to oppose, उ Uṇādi aff. and ध changed to ह.

m. (-कः)
1 A crab.
2 A gallinule.
3 A plant, (Asclepias gigantea.)
4 The digger of a tank, (जलखातके.)
E.
बहु much, कन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A servant, servile, dependant.
m. (-कः)
1 The name of NALA, after his change of form, by the bite of KARKOṬAKA

Nāga.
2

A monkey.
f. (-का)
The name of a river.
E.
बाहु an arm, कन् aff. or कृ to do, with ड aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A prickly plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
2 The marshy date tree.
E.
बहु many, कण्ट a thorn, कन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 A sweeper.
2 Industrious, labouring.
m. (-रः)
A camel.
f. (-री)
A broom.
E.
बहु much, कृ to do, अप् or टच् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Patient, enduring.
m. (-मः)
A Jaina deified saint.
E.
बहु much, and क्षम to bear, aff. ण.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Smelling, strong-scented.
m. (-न्धः)
Olibanum.
f. (-न्धा)
1 Arabian jasmine.
2 The bud of the Champac.
E.
बहु much, गन्ध odour.

mfn. (-वाक्)
Talking much, and blameably.
E.
बहु much, गर्ह्य reproachable, and वाच् speech.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Many times.
2 Having many good qualities.
E.
बहु, and गुण quality, &c.

m. (-न्थिः)
Tamarisk, (Tamarix diœca.)
E.
बहु many, and ग्रन्थि a knot or joint.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
What takes or holds much.
E.
बहु, and ग्रह what takes.

mfn. (-न्त्रिः-न्त्री-न्त्रि)
Many-fibred, (applicable only to the body.)
E.
वहु many, and तन्त्री a string.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Many-stringed, (a musical instrument, &c.)
E.
बहु many, तन्त्री a wire, and कप् added.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Much, many, most.
E.
तरप् aff. added to बहु.

ind.
From or by much, or many.
E.
बहु much, तसि aff.

mfn. (-थः-थी-थं)
Manieth, (the ordinary of many.)
E.
बहु many, much, डट् aff. and तिथुक् augment.

ind.
In many ways, or places, &c.
E.
बहु much, many, त्रल् aff.

n. (त्वं)
Plurality, multitude, muchness, abundance.
E.
बहु much, त्व aff. of the abstract.

m. (-क्कः)
The Bhoj, or Birch tree.
E.
बहु much, त्वच् skin or bark, कन् aff. having several layers of bark.

m. (-त्वक्)
The Bhojpatra, or Birch tree.
E.
बहु much, and त्वच् bark: see the last.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Liberal, munificent.
E.
बहु, and द who gives.

f. (-दा)
The name of a river, said to rise in the snowy chain of the Himālaya, and probably the modern Behut, the classical Hydaspes.
E.
बाहु an arm, and दा bestower; alluding to a legend of a saint's recovering his lost arms, by bathing in this stream.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Accompanied with many presents, (a ceremony.)
2 Liberal, bountiful.
E.
बहु, and दक्षिणा a gift.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having many staff-bearers, &c.
E.
बहु many, दण्डिन् having a staff, कन् aff.; also in the masculine form बहुदण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी)

m. (-ग्धः)
Wheat.
f. (-ग्धा)
A cow giving much milk.
E.
बहु much, and टुग्ध milk.

f. (-काः)
A plant, yielding a caustic milky juice, (Euphorbia, of various sorts.)
E.
बहु much, टुग्ध milk, कन् aff., fem. form.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Full of faults or defects, very wicked, very bad.
E.
बहु, and दोष fault.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Experienced.
E.
बहु, and दृष्ट seen.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wealthy, rich.
E.
बहु, and धन wealth.

ind.
In many ways, sorts, &c.
E.
बहु much, धाच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dispersed, scattered.
E.
बहुधा, and गत gone.

m. (-रः)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
बहु many, धारा edge.

m. (-दः)
The conch shell.
E.
बहु much, नाद sound.

mfn. (-टुः-ट्वी-टु)
Very clever.
E.
बहु much, and पटु clever.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
Many-leaved.
m. (-त्रः)
An onion.
n. (-त्रं)
Talc.
f. (-त्री)
A drug, (Trigonella foenugræcum.)
E.
बहु many, पत्र a leaf, &c.

f. (-र्णी)
A medicinal plant, (Trigonella fœnugræcum.)
E.
बहु many, पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-पाद्)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
बहु many, पाद foot; also बहुपाद.
m. (-दः)
alluding to the branches, which grow downwards and take root again.

mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्री-त्त्रं)
Having many children.
m. (-त्त्रः)
A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
f. (-त्त्री)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus).
E.
बहु many, पुत्त्र a child or produce.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Having a numerous progeny.
m. (-जः)
1 A hog.
2 A sort of grass: see मुञ्ज.
E.
बहु many, प्रजा offspring.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Complicated, containing more than one circumstance.
2 (In law) Comprising many counts, (a plaint, &c.)
E.
बहु many, प्रतिज्ञा assent.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Munificent, bountiful.
E.
बहु much, and प्रद who gives.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Flowing in many streams.
E.
बहु, and प्रवाह course.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of many children.
E.
बहु much, and प्रसू who bears offspring.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Fertile, fruitful.
m. (-लः)
The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.)
f. (-ली)
The opposite leaved fig tree.
E.
बहु much, फल fruit.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Fortunate.
E.
बहु, and भाग्य fortune.

mfn. (-भुक्)
Voracious.
E.
बहु, and भुज् who eats.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thought much of, respected, considered.
2 Having many different opinions.
E.
बहु, and मत minded.

f. (-तिः)
Value, estimation, prizing or preferring.
E.
बहु, and मति mind.

m. (-लं)
Lead.
E.
बहु much, मल dirt.

m. (-र्गः)
A place where four roads meet.
E.
बहु many, मार्ग a road.

n. (-नं)
Respect, reverence.
E.
बहु, and मान respect.

mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति)
Multiform.
f. (-र्त्तिः)
Wild cotton.
E.
बहु many, भूर्त्ति form.

mfn. (-र्द्धा-र्द्धा-र्द्ध)
Many-headed.
m. (-र्द्धः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
बहु many, मूर्द्धन् a forehead.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Many-rooted, having many roots.
m. (-लः)
A sort of reed or grass: see इक्कट and इत्कट.
E.
बहु many, and मूल a root; also with कन् added, बहुमूलक m. (-कः)

n. (-लं)
The arm-pit.
E.
बाहु the arm, मूल the root.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Costly, precious.
E.
बहु much, and मूल price, aff. यत्.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Multiform.
m. (-पः)
1

Resin.
2
Ś

IVA.
3
VIṢṆ
Love,

CUPID.
5

A chameleon.
6

BRAHMĀ.
7

Hair.
8

One of the Jinas or Jaina saints.
E.
बहु many, रूप shape.

बहुरेख^1
m. plu. (-खाः)
Wrinkles, furrows, marks of care or pain.
E.
बहु many, रेखा a line.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161210. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 306. note: m. noun.

m. (-ताः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
बहु much, and रेतम् seed.

m. (-मा)
A sheep.
E.
बहु much, and रोमन् hair.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Much, many.
2

Black.
3

Variously applicable, comprehensive, (a rule, &c.)
m. (-लः)
1 AGNI or fire.
2 The dark half of a month.
n. (-लं)
The sky.
f. plu. (-लाः)
The Pleiades.
f. (-ला)
1

Indigo.
2

Cardamoms.
3

A cow.
E.
बहु many, ला to get, aff. क.

m. (-लः)
1 Fire or its deity.
2 The month Kārttika.
n. (-लं)
1 Mail worn on the arm.
2 A term in grammar, implying various or irregular formation, or construction, or such as is analogous to this word.
E.
बहुल fire, and अण् aff.; also with कन् added, बाहुलक.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Abundance, muchness.
2 Comprehensiveness, (of a rule.)
E.
त्व added to the last; also with तल् बहुलता.

n. (-णं)
1 Multiplying, magnifying, making much.
2 Winnowing.
E.
बहुल, and करण making, with च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Threshed and winnowed.
2 Made manifold or much.
E.
बहुल much, कृत made, and च्चि substituted for the final of the former, by which the ई is inserted.

n. (-नः)
The plural number, (in grammar.)
E.
बहु, and वचन saying.

m. (-रः)
A fruit, (Cordia myxa.)
E.
बहु much, वॄ to nourish, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, बहुवारक m. (-कः)

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Various, multiform, of many sorts or kinds.
E.
बहु many, and विध sort.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Widely spread or diffused.
f. (-र्णा)
A shrub bearing a small red and black berry, (Abrus precatorius.)
E.
बहु much, विलीर्ण spreading.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Having many or much seed.
n. (-जं)
The custard apple, (Annona squamosa.)
E.
बहु many, and वीज a seed.

m. (-र्य्यः)
Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.)
E.
वहु much, and वीर्य्य seed.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Personal prowess.
E.
बाहु, and वीर्य्य heroism.

m. (-हिः)
One of the forms of grammatical composition, the compounding two or more words to furnish an epithet or attributive, as बहुमाल or बहुमालक having many necklaces, from वहु, and माला A necklace.
E.
बहु many, and व्रीहि grain.

mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु)
Having many enemies.
m. (-त्रुः)
A sparrow.
E.
बहु many, and शत्रु an enemy.

ind.
Abundantly, plentifully.
E.
बहु much, many, शस् aff.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Having many branches or ramifications.
E.
बहु, and शाखा a branch.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well taught, learned.
2 Acquainted with the Vedas.
E.
बहु, and श्रुत heard, or श्रुति Vedas.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Having many excellencies.
2 Very excellent.
E.
बहु, and श्रेयस् best.

mfn. (स्पृक्)
Expanded, spread, diffused.
E.
बहु, and स्पृश् what touches.

m. (-तिः)
A species of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa)
E.
बहु much, सन्तति spreading.

f. (-ता)
A plant, (Asparagus.)
E.
बहु many, सुत a birth or shoot.

f. (-सूः)
1 A sow.
2 The mother of many children.
E.
बहु many, and सू bearing.

f. (-तिः)
A cow bearing many calves.
E.
बहु many, सू to bear, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-नः)
An owl.
E.
बहु much, स्वन noise or sound.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having much water.
E.
बहु, and उदक water.

r. 1st cl. (बह्लते)
1 To be pre-eminent or excellent, (also वह्ल, but less usually.)
2 To speak or tell.
3 To kill or hurt.
4 To cover, to spread.
5 To give, (also बह्ल in these five senses, and more accurately.)
6 To remember.
r. 10th cl. (बह्लयति)
To shine.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Important, having much meaning.
2 Having many objects.
E.
बहु, and अर्थ meaning.

m. (-त्यः)
1 A hog.
2 A rat.
f. (-त्या)
A cow that has borne many calves.
E.
बहु many, अपत्य offspring.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Voracious, gluttonous.
E.
बहु much, आशिन् who eats.

f. (-ह्वृक्)
The Ṛg Veda.
E.
बहु many, ऋच् a hymn or prayer.

f. (-ची)
The wife of a Brahman conversant with the Ṛg Veda.
E.
बहु many, ऋच् a prayer or incantation, aff. ङीप्.

(ऋ) बाहृ r. 1st cl. (बाहते)
1 To resolve, to attempt perseveringly or resolutely, to endeavour diligently; also वाहृ.

mf. (-हः-हा)
The arm.
E.
बाह to endeavour, aff. अच्; it is sometimes read वाह.

m. (-न्थः)
A wing.
E.
बाहु the arm, कुन्थ what adheres to, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं)
Crooked armed.
E.
बाहु an arm, and कुब्ज bent.

m. (-जः)
1 The Kṣatriya or warrior, born from the arms of

BRAHMĀ.
2

A parrot.
3 Sesamum growing wild, or spontaneously.
E.
बाहु the arm, and ज born.

n. (-णं)
Armour for the arms.
E.
बाहु the arm, and त्राण preserving.

m. (-न्ती)
INDRA.
E.
बाहु an arm, दन्त a tooth, aff. इनि.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
A striker, a boxer.
n. (-णं)
Boxing, wrestling.
E.
बाहु, and प्रहरण striking.

f. (-षा)
An armlet, an ornament worn round the upper arm.
E.
बाहु the arm, and भूषा an ornament.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made or done with the arms.
E.
बाहु, and मयट् aff.

n. (-द्धं)
Close fight, personal struggle, boxing, wrestling.
E.
बाहु the arm, and युद्ध fight.

m. (-यः)
The deity KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
बाहुला the Pleiades, considered as nymphs, and nurses of this god; aff. of relation ढक्.

n. (-ल्यं)
Plenty, abundance, quantity.
E.
बहुल, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-भृत्)
A king killed by PARAŚURĀMA, also named KĀRTAVĪRYA.
E.
बाहु an arm, सहस्र a thousand, and भृत् having.

ind.
Arm to arm, hand to hand, (fighting, &c.)
E.
बाहु the arm, repeated, इच् aff.
